title: Juicy English Fish Fillet Bangers And Mash
description: A briny, pillowy, indulgent British dish featuring fish fillet, braise, and plant-based-friendly bangers and mash, perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, boil the chopped potatoes in salted water until they are tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the chopped carrots to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the vegetarian sausages to the skillet and cook until they are browned on all sides.
In a large baking dish, combine the cooked potatoes, onion, carrots, and sausages.
Place the cod fish fillet on top of the potato mixture and season with salt and black pepper.
Pour the vegetable broth over the fish and potato mixture.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
